variants.name: Sensory Ataxic Neuropathy (SAN)
variants.description: A maternally inherited nerve disease of Golden Retrievers caused by a one-base deletion in a mitochondrial tRNA gene: affected dogs develop progressive incoordination from adolescence. All affected dogs trace to a single 1970s maternal ancestor, so absence is the expected result outside that line.

note: Mitochondrial disease variants are inherited only through the mother and can be heteroplasmic (present in a fraction of mitochondria); the screen reports the share of sequencing reads carrying each variant.

excluded.name: Mitochondrial leukoencephalomyelopathy (mt-CYB m.14474G>A / V98M)
excluded.reason: Excluded after internal population screening: 11 of 97 healthy multi-breed reference dogs carry the allele at 85-97% heteroplasmy, clustering with specific maternal sub-lineages — in the general population this is a neutral haplogroup marker, and the two-family 2006 association (Li et al.) does not justify flagging it in healthy dogs.
